title: Disney offers jobs to most of Character.AI's staff in a bankruptcy bid
friendlyTitle: Disney offers jobs to most of Character.AI's staff
summary: TechCrunch reports that a bankruptcy filing shows Disney has agreed to offer jobs to at least 60 Character.AI employees, described as the majority of the workforce, at an estimated $60 million a year in pay. The filing says the vast majority of people who received offers accepted. Character.AI's former chief executive is already Disney's first chief technology officer, and the startup had previously said Disney agreed to buy some assets for $20 million. The bid is a stalking-horse offer, so another buyer can still outbid it.
friendlySummary: A bankruptcy filing says Disney has agreed to offer jobs to at least 60 Character.AI employees, most of the company, at about $60 million a year in pay. Most people who got an offer accepted. The old chief executive is already Disney's first technology chief. Another buyer can still make a higher bid.
whyItMatters: If you use Character.AI, the filing does not say the product shuts down tomorrow. It does say the company cited high costs and possible litigation and regulatory exposure, and that most of the team may now sit inside Disney unless a higher bid appears.
